description: For every code-enumerable axiom set \(T\) in an effective signature, the numerical codes of its semantic consequences are computably enumerable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.enumerable_theory_consequences.{u_1, u_2} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) (T : L.Theory)
  (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.CodeEnumerable S T) :
  REPred fun n => ∃ A, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.sentenceCode S A = n ∧ T ⊨ᵇ A
